plane-light.name: the Plane of Light
plane-light.arrivalText: Gold light pulses through the cave: when the stones around you start to glow, step off them before the flare.

plane-shadow.name: the Plane of Shadow
plane-shadow.arrivalText: Darkness presses in: you see only a short way here, and farther when you stand in the violet glow of the crystals.

plane-earth.name: the Plane of Earth
plane-earth.arrivalText: The cave groans: when dust starts to trickle, step off the marked stones before the rocks fall.

plane-fire.name: the Plane of Fire
plane-fire.arrivalText: The basalt is split with molten rock: it cannot be crossed, and standing beside it scorches you. When the roof glows, get out from under it.

plane-water.name: the Plane of Water
plane-water.arrivalText: The deep water drags you down: cross it only if you must. When the water starts to draw back, a surge is coming.

plane-air.name: the Plane of Air
plane-air.arrivalText: Updraft vents throw you off your feet, and the gales here come with a warning. Watch where you are standing.

portal-rule-biome-1.planeChoice: uniform among planes with a roster
portal-rule-biome-1.portalFloor: uniform over base+1..base+4, rerolled until it is not the Forge floor (base+3 or base+4, 50% each)

portal-rule-biome-3.planeChoice: uniform among planes with a roster

portal-placement-room.when: host floor has a portal and is not a boss floor
portal-placement-room.stage: after Crypt ooze and wall vegetation, before the Caverns finish
portal-placement-room.order: Manhattan distance from room centre to the arrival cell, farthest first
portal-placement-room.onFail: no portal (the plane is lost for the run)
portal-placement-room.ruling: ruled 2026-10-15: one rule for both portal biomes: the farthest qualifying room from arrival, then the reachable-from-stairs repair; a portal floor never loses its plane

portal-placement-underdark-repair.from: first STAIRS cell in scan order; BFS over generation route cells
portal-placement-underdark-repair.choose: greatest walking distance from the stairs, first in row-major order on ties
portal-placement-underdark-repair.onMove: old portal tile to FLOOR; room role portal if unset; note added unless one already mentions "portal to"

plane-entry.noRosterLog: The portal flickers and will not hold. Nothing lies beyond it yet.
plane-entry.failLog: The plane could not be prepared. You remain on floor {floor}. Try the portal again.
steps: stash host floor (creatures minus player and allies, keys, action counter, clock)

arrival.log: You step through the portal into {planeTitle}.
arrival.playerCell: entry cell + inward direction, else the portal

plane-entry.floorNumber: the host floor for travel and loot; combat amounts are fixed per creature and hazard

effects.arrival: entry cell + inward direction, else the portal

plane-exit.log: You step back into the {biomeName}. Behind you the portal gutters and goes dark.
plane-exit.noStashLog: The portal flickers but nothing happens.
plane-exit.stairsDownLog: There are no stairs in {planeTitle}. The portal is the way home.
plane-exit.hostClocks: paused while away (rebased on return); restored creatures take the player clock
plane-exit.eliteDeathLog: The guardian of {planeTitle} falls. Its treasure waits in the grotto.
plane-exit.ruling: ruled 2026-10-15: the leave prompt also says when the rune chest is still unopened

plane-layout.blobRule: cells within (rx+2, ry+2), inside margin 2; a = atan2(y-cy, x-cx); wob = round ? 1 + 0.06 sin(4a + cx) : 1 + 0.18 sin(3a + cx) + 0.12 sin(5a + cy); inside when ((x-cx)/(rx wob))^2 + ((y-cy)/(ry wob))^2 <= 1
plane-layout.tunnelRule: carve a width x width square at the cell; up to 400 steps: 72% along the larger remaining axis, else 50/50 x or y toward the target (random -1..1 if aligned); clamp 2..53 x 2..31; carve after each step

build.secondSeal: 4-way from the cell inside the portal

outcrop.score: (x - Px) + 1.2 (Py - y) - 1.5 |d - 6|, d = distance from P to (x+1.5, y+1)

rules: not a chokepoint (open orthogonal sides only opposite, or <= 4 open of 8)

reachabilityFix.from: first walkable cell in scan order

plane-dress-fire.exclude: not FLOOR, prop, item, or Manhattan <= 2 of portal or chest
plane-dress-fire.pourShape: hypot(x-x0, 1.35 (y-y0)) <= rad (1 + w sin(3a + x0) + 0.6 w sin(5a + y0)), cells within rad+1
plane-dress-fire.pourCheck: undo the whole pour if any walkable cell becomes unreachable from the player

grottoPool.cells: old water cells with 4 water neighbours, free

plane-dress-fire.blockedMoveLog: Molten rock. You cannot cross it.

scatter.needs: prop-free FLOOR with a wall orthogonally beside

plane-dress-fire.ruling: ruled 2026-10-15: no decorative lava pool on the Fire plane

plane-dress-water.deep: WATER (x 1..54, y 1..32) with 4 orthogonal WATER neighbours (walkable)

plane-creature-placement.regulars: 12 + 2 x host floor position in biome (1..4): 14, 16, 18, 20

elite.at: random free cell within 3 of (cx, cy+2), else the centre

plane-creature-placement.ruling: ruled 2026-10-15: hazards spare bodies flagged plane-native (creature-flag), set on each roster kind, the elite and the Heart of the Mountain's limbs and nodes

essence.base: round((80 + 40 x rnd) x biome essence multiplier)
essence.ruling: scaled once, at pickup (planes.md answer 6, packet C items.md question 8)

plane-rune-chest.spot: random free cell within 2 of the chest
plane-rune-chest.log: The rune chest opens: treasure of {planeTitle}.

effects.note: the biome essence multiplier applies once, at pickup (planes.md answer 6)

plane-drops-regular.appliesTo: every plane creature without its own table, including the light, shadow and earth elites

plane-drops-elite-fwa.ruling: ruled 2026-10-15: all six guardians use this table (60%: essence 6, gear 8, sigil 2)

cells.shade: no orthogonal neighbour prop named crystal, stalagmite, rune or dais

plane-hazard-shadow-darkness.litTest: within 2 (Chebyshev, fractional) of any plane light

plane-hazard-snuffed.offPlane: caps sight at 2 but does not count down off a plane

plane-hazard-lava-standing.ruling: ruled 2026-10-15: every body takes the same damage; levitating and flying bodies are exempt

plane-hazard-deep-water.ruling: Fixed ice damage; levitating, flying and plane-native bodies are exempt.

player.direction: (sign cos a, sign sin a), a uniform angle (always diagonal)

plane-hazard-updraft-vent.ruling: ruled 2026-10-15: a vent pushes toward a uniformly chosen one of the 8 neighbours

plane-terrain-test-room.placement: centred: ox = floor((56-28)/2) = 14, oy = floor((34-19)/2) = 7; everything outside is WALL
